headline: Intuitive Collaborates with Deion “Coach Prime” Sanders to Raise Patient Awareness of Surgical Options
summary: Collaboration aims to help patients feel more informed, prepared and engaged in their care SUNNYVALE, Calif., July 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Intuitive (NASDAQ: ISRG), a global technology leader in minimally invasive care and the pioneer of robotic-assisted surgery, today announced a collaboration with Deion “Coach Prime” Sanders to help increase patient awareness and understanding of surgical options, including robotic-assisted surgery with da Vinci systems. headline: The ACA Coverage Debate Just Became a $50 Billion Question for Intuitive Surgical
summary: Health policy has quietly become a stock-moving variable in 2026, and the figures are significant enough to matter. Approximately 2.6 million Americans discontinued ACA marketplace coverage this year after increased pandemic-era subsidies ended at the end of 2025, with health policy experts predicting that total enrollment would decrease to between 16.5 million and 17.5 million […]
